## Learning Grove · Live Data Tables demo
Fictional records only.
GET catalog: approved courses/resources + rules-based matching.
POST submit: validates fictional contacts and upserts pending submissions.
No AI, Airtable, enrollment, notifications, or public submission listing.
Demo endpoints are public; do not use for real personal data.
Review pending records directly in the n8n Submissions table.
